body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 88b5893e9125ed995c183fbb86e54a3bd3bc0f5f -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the branch conflicts with current main on two snapshot goldens, and the light shell snapshot does not pass on the review machine.

**What looks good**
- `pick::align_321` is pure and every refusal names what to re-pick (`wcs_align::every_missing_or_doubled_datum_is_refused_by_name`).
- The frame maths checks out: the Shepperd branches match the standard rotation-matrix-to-quaternion formulas, the quaternion is local-to-world (consistent with `transform_point`), and the angle round trip is pinned.
- The button goes through the existing undoable `SetWcs` command; `face_origin::align_wcs_321_places_g54_from_the_face_and_edge_picks` asserts that undo moves G54 back.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in non-test code; the `expect` calls are all in `crates/app/tests/wcs_align.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/face_origin.rs`.
- `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs` is 259 lines and carries a provenance line.

**Local results (PR head, trial merge not clean - see below)**

Trial merge with `origin/main`: conflicts in `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png` and `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app_light.png` (and `RECOMMENDED.md`, append-only). Aborted; the PR head was reviewed unmerged.

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `wcs_align` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `vertex_pick` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `pick` (app) | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 238 passed, 1 failed, 2 ignored |
| `face_origin` (in the ui lib) | both tests pass, incl. `align_wcs_321_places_g54_from_the_face_and_edge_picks` |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure:
```
test egui_app::tests::egui_shell_snapshot_light ... FAILED
Snapshot errors:
  'egui_app_light' Image did not match snapshot. Diff: 1, .../crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app_light.diff.png.
  Failing pixels by threshold: 0.0: 5328, 0.1: 4166, 0.2: 2612, 0.4: 565, 0.6: 1, 1.0: 0, ...
```

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch and regenerate `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/egui_app.png` and `egui_app_light.png` (`UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`, CWD `crates/ui`), then push. Main has moved these goldens since 8b3163d; the PR body already flags the overlap with #188.
2. The light shell snapshot fails here with scattered sub-pixel differences (1 pixel at 0.6, the rest at or below 0.4) that are not clustered on the new button. That looks like software-GL antialiasing rather than the change. Please confirm the regenerated goldens pass on your machine, or say which platform they were made on.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `geo_page.rs` calls `align_321` on every frame to set the button's enabled state and tooltip. Cheap for now; worth a look if the pick list grows.
- `RECOMMENDED.md` ledger entry is present (#187).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
